title: Architecture Exploration
description: Map RC10 closeout blockers into RC11 AIOS-body workflow boundaries and ownership.
findings: RC11 must keep mirror and signer as external transport inputs while AIOS owns descriptor validation, drift-zero reconciliation, installer quarantine verification, AgentCore PlanSpec binding, SecurityExecutionEngine effect gating, audit, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.

title: Implementation Exploration
description: Find existing RC8-RC10 task/script/evidence patterns to follow for RC11 planning.
findings: Use existing Production Distro patterns: plan.json plus workflow-session.json, per-task .task JSON, docs, evidence JSON, and scripts under scripts/project-rc*.ps1 or scripts/run-rc*-*.ps1. Keep generated runtime artifacts under .workflow/artifacts when later tasks execute.

title: Integration Exploration
description: Identify integration touch points and non-goals for AIOS body work only.
findings: RC11 touches local workflow metadata, release object verification scripts, installer quarantine verifier, AgentCore/SecurityExecution execution packets, canary enrollment evidence, rollback drill evidence, support/recovery binding, and final audit. Mirror frontend, nginx, remote signer, remote dispatch, and production ring mutation are out of scope.

title: Risk Exploration
description: Identify safety risks and required fail-closed controls for RC11.
findings: Main risks are treating endpoint reachability as trust, bypassing drift-zero, interpreting payload bytes before quarantine verification, broad approvals, single-node canary projection, rollback without separate approval, and leaking signing material. All tasks keep production_ready_claim=false until final audit proves gates.

title: Plan Generation
description: Generate RC11 execution plan and task graph from exploration findings.
findings: Created WFS-20260609-agentos-production-distro-rc11 with RC11-000 completed planning evidence and RC11-001 as next executable task. Plan has 5 waves after planning and preserves AIOS-body-only scope.
